ai.overview: Arizona puts the College Basketball Belt on the line for the first time in their current reign when they host New Orleans on December 1, 2026. The Wildcats claimed the belt somewhere in their recent stretch and now face a Privateers program that has never held the championship. This marks the first time these programs will meet with the lineal title at stake.
key_matchups: Arizona riding a 4-game winning streak including an 85-79 victory over UConn in their most recent outing
New Orleans looking to claim their first-ever belt after bouncing back with a 75-70 road win at Texas Southern
Arizona's 3-0 all-time edge in the series, though the teams haven't met since 1993
ai.betting_angles: Arizona enters with a 4-1 record and winners of their last 4 games, while New Orleans sits at 1-2 with just one win in their last 5 outings. The Wildcats hold a perfect 3-0 mark in the all-time series, with their most recent meeting in 1993 resulting in an 80-62 Arizona victory. Our Elo model projects Arizona as a clear favorite in this matchup.
ai.prediction_writeup: Arizona's current form is vastly superior, having won their last 4 games including quality victories over UConn and Auburn. New Orleans has struggled badly in recent outings, posting losses of 41-86 at Texas Tech and 57-100 at LSU before their lone recent win. The Wildcats' 3-0 all-time dominance in this series and clear Elo edge point to a comfortable home victory. Arizona should retain the belt with relative ease in their first defense of this reign.
